_about: Aristophanes in English, translator per title. Complete: The Eleven Comedies, 'now for the first time literally and completely translated' (anonymous, The Athenian Society, 1912), 2 vols. Single plays: W. J. Hickie's prose Clouds (Bohn), B. B. Rogers's verse Frogs, Jack Lindsay's Lysistrata (1926; Gutenberg treats it as US public domain; Lindsay d. 1990, so not PD in life+70 countries). PG 3012, 2571 and 3013 were checked by 8-word shingle overlap (0.85-0.87) and are the Athenian Society translation split out, so they are excluded as duplicates.

aristophanes-athenian-v1: The Eleven Comedies, vol. 1: Knights, Acharnians, Peace, Lysistrata, The Clouds
aristophanes-athenian-v2: The Eleven Comedies, vol. 2: Wasps, Birds, Frogs, Thesmophoriazusae, Ecclesiazusae, Plutus
aristophanes-lindsay-lysistrata: tr. Jack Lindsay (1926); US PD per Gutenberg

aristophanes-frere-morley: Aristophanes: a Metrical Version of the Acharnians, the Knights and the Birds (Morley's Universal Library; 2nd ed., Routledge, 1887)
aristophanes-hickie-1887-v1: The Comedies of Aristophanes, a new and literal translation, vol. I: Acharnians, Knights, Clouds, Wasps, Peace, Birds (Bohn; London: George Bell, 1887)
aristophanes-mitchell-1822-v2: The Comedies of Aristophanes, vol. II: The Clouds, The Wasps (London: John Murray, 1822)
